# Framing taken from a real Vitocharge VX3 bus -- the CAN identifiers,
# the sequence bytes, the datapoint numbers, the type bytes, and the way
# messages segment and get interrupted. Every type byte the stream uses
# is covered, which is the point: a type byte with no branch in the
# parser makes those messages vanish silently.
#
# Every payload byte is synthetic, an ascending pattern. Only the framing
# is under test, and the real bytes were measurements, counters and
# serial numbers from somebody's house.
# 253 frames -> 33 messages, 3 abandoned
